$comment: Phase 4 LLM acceptance prompts. Each prompt is a one-sentence user intent that an LLM with the Froglet MCP should turn into a single marketplace_publish call. Per-cell criteria define what 'pass' means.

prompts.user_intent: Publish a Froglet service that translates English to Spanish. Use a simple deterministic mock — return the input prefixed with 'es:' so I can test the pipeline.
Publish a Froglet service that takes any JSON object and returns its SHA-256 hash.
Register a Python function on Froglet that takes a JSON {text: string} and returns the reversed text.
Deploy a JSON validator service on Froglet. It accepts {schema, data} and returns {valid: bool, errors: list}.
Publish a Froglet service that echoes input back unchanged.
